Pinned source uses env!(CARGO_BIN_EXE_cagents) directly for the subprocess command; the manifest names the exact ordinary src/main.rs target without required features. Together with admitted tool/source/context and the strict same-original-command/package pair, this supports the requested bounded name-to-artifact contract. It does not extract the compiled value, attest every child exec or establish a current physical Cargo version. The version tag is not a resolved commit and web-response hashes are not raw upstream-file hashes.
